panel.name: plus_detach
panel.panel.string: Show in a window of its own (to put on another monitor; the button there puts it back)
Put back in the main window (or drag the title bar onto the main window; hold Ctrl to keep it apart)
Up to [MAX] windows can be shown apart. Put one back in the main window first.
[TITLE] cannot be shown in a window of its own.
Click a window first, then choose this again.
Windows of their own need the Vulkan renderer.
